title: Completed localization of actual chart sections
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion, U open in Spec A, q:Y → U, s:E → Spec C, E affine, and D the supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let t ∈ ℕ and f:Fin t → A with D(f_i) contained in U and V_i=(q followed by U inclusion)⁻¹D(f_i) affine. Use the fixed completed and chart section modules [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. There exist A-linear alpha_i:(Γ(E,top))_(f_i) ≃ C tensor_A M_i and additive d_i:C tensor_A M_i ≃ Γ(O,p⁻¹V_i), where O=Y ×_U (Spec C restricted to U), p:O → Y. The alpha_i commute with the localized C-action. Their generator values satisfy d_i(alpha_i(m/1))=restriction of D.toCompleted^*(m), and d_i(1 tensor n)=p^*n. Also d_i(z x)=the structural C-section of z times d_i(x). The alpha_i and d_i are constructed together, not supplied arbitrarily.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs; Tag 05EL, item (1).

proof.text: The affine base-change section formula constructs d_i, sending z tensor m to the product of the structural C-section z with the pullback of m. Since f_i is invertible on V_i, base change over U is the same as base change over Spec A on this chart. The equation D.over identifies p⁻¹V_i with the principal open defined by f_i in E. Affineness of E identifies its sections with localization of completed global sections. Compose this localization map with sections of the overlap isomorphism and d_i inverse to obtain alpha_i. On m/f_i^n this is d_i inverse of the restriction of D.toCompleted^*(m) divided by the structural section f_i^n. The pure-tensor and fraction formulas give d_chart and d_prime. Multiplication by structural C-sections gives alpha_smul and d_scalar. Empty principal opens have zero modules, so the constructions apply there too.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BLH, affine chart section construction; Tag 05EL, item (1).
